blocks.text: The Thai Meteorological Department (TMD) has warned of thundershowers, gusty winds and isolated heavy to very heavy rain in upper Thailand from October 4 to 7, 2026. The affected areas are: The unsettled weather is caused by a high-pressure system, or cold air mass, from China extending over the North and upper Northeast late in the rainy season, initially triggering thundershowers.
